description: Query tasks; read-only. Defaults to all non-deleted tasks unless status is explicit.

include_deleted.description: include deleted tasks in addition to the default non-deleted set; ignored when status is explicit

project.description: project slug in the effective workspace

query.description: filter expression combining predicates with and/or/not (lowercase) and parens; space-separated terms mean implicit AND. Predicates: '+tag' or '-tag' to require/exclude a tag (do NOT write 'tag:...'); a bare word matches the title substring; 'field:value' for equality; suffixes '.before'/'.after'/'.isnull'/'.notnull' for dates (no other suffixes). Common fields: status(pending|completed|deleted|waiting), priority(H|M|L), project, assignee, due/start/end. Dates: today, tomorrow, YYYY-MM-DD, now+24h. Examples: '+work status:pending', 'due.before:tomorrow and priority:H', 'start.notnull'. An explicit status predicate overrides the default non-deleted visibility.

sort.description: task sort expression, for example due, due-, urgency-

status.description: explicit task status filter; overrides default non-deleted visibility

workspace.description: workspace slug or UUID; omit to use the actor's default workspace

name: task_query
